packages.label: דֶּרֶךְ חָכְמָה וְהֵרָיוֹן
packages.label_en: The Path of Wisdom and Spiritual Gestation
packages.reason: These three pairs all describe the same essential reality: a spiritual path (derech) in its gestation phase is identical in nature to a pregnant woman. (E2) הדרך חכמה בעצמו = אשה הרה — the path of wisdom itself IS the pregnant woman; both are vessels of unrevealed potential awaiting the right moment of birth. (E5) כשמתחיל לכנס לאיזה דרך = הריון — the moment of entering a new path IS pregnancy in its essential nature; the Rebbe states explicitly 'כשמתחיל לכנס לאיזה דרך הוא בחינת הריון'. (E1) נפסד גם הדרך חכמה בעצמו באפן שאפלו איש אחר אינו יכול לכנס לשם = מיתת האשה הרה — the total ruin of the path IS the death of the pregnant woman; both describe the catastrophic termination not merely of its fruit but of its very generative capacity. All three pairs are expressions of the same domain: the holy path that must gestate in hiddenness before being revealed to the world.
nodes: נפסד גם הדרך חכמה בעצמו, באפן שאפלו איש אחר אינו יכול לכנס לשם בבחינת הריון, לגלות ולהוציא זה הדרך לעולם

merge_notes.reason: Three raw connected components (E1, E2, E5) are merged into one package because all three share the same essential nature: the spiritual derech and its gestation phase. (E2) הדרך חכמה = אשה הרה: the path IS the pregnant woman. (E5) כניסה לדרך = הריון: entering a path IS pregnancy. (E1) הרס הדרך = מיתת האשה הרה: destruction of the path IS the woman's death. These are not cause-and-effect — each pair states a bechina identity (A IS B), and all three pairs illuminate the same thematic family: the path of wisdom as a living, gestating entity that can be born or killed. The E1 long node is a descriptive formulation of הדרך חכמה בעצמו in its destroyed state, which is functionally the same domain node as E2's הדרך חכמה בעצמו, making E1 a further specification within the same pregnancy metaphor domain.

packages.label: מְפֻרְסָמִים קֹדֶם זְמַנָּם וּנְפָלִים
packages.label_en: Those Made Famous Before Their Time and Stillborn Fetuses
packages.reason: Two pairs describing the same essential nature from slightly different angles. (E3) המפרסמים שנעשין קדם זמנם = נפלים — those who are made famous before their time ARE stillborn fetuses (plural); the Rebbe states 'הם בבחינות נפלים כנ"ל'. (E4) יוצא קדם זמנו = נפל — one who goes out before his time IS a stillborn (singular). Both pairs are bechina statements equating premature emergence with stillbirth. They belong in the same package because they are two formulations of the identical equivalence (one plural, one singular; one referring to the group, one to the individual). The polarity is neutral: these persons are not the evil agents (machloket-makers are the cause) but rather the metaphorical victims — the premature births. They are structural metaphor-objects describing the effect of controversy on spiritual emergence, capable of existing in any spiritual context.

merge_notes.reason: E3 and E4 are merged into one package because both encode the same bechina: premature revelation = spiritual stillbirth. E3 states it in the plural (those who become famous = nfalim) and E4 in the singular (one who goes out before time = nefal). The shared nature is identical across both edges — premature emergence is stillbirth. This is pure bechina (shared nature), not eitza: the prematurely-revealed person does not produce the stillborn, they ARE the stillborn.
